Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, per-pool rate from CLPool.fee() applied to each swap's input amount.
Fees.External Bribes Rewards: External incentives deposited by third parties to the voter bribe/incentive contracts (NotifyReward events).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, per-pool rate from CLPool.fee() applied to each swap's input amount.

Revenue.Staked-LP Swap Fees: Fees earned by staked liquidity plus the unstaked-LP rake, forwarded to veRAPH voters.
Revenue.External Bribes Revenue: External incentives deposited by third parties, claimable by veRAPH voters.

HoldersRevenue.Staked-LP Swap Fees: Fees earned by staked liquidity plus the unstaked-LP rake, forwarded to veRAPH voters.
HoldersRevenue.External Bribes Revenue: External incentives deposited by third parties, claimable by veRAPH voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Unstaked-LP Swap Fees: Unstaked liquidity providers' share of swap fees, net of the unstaked-LP rake redirected to the gauge.

methodology.Fees: Everything users pay the protocol: the price of every cat minted, the trading fee the hook takes on the $HASH pool, and the secondary-market royalty the collection routes to the hook. The mint price is derived per cat from the contract's own curve - the number of cats created so far times PRICE_STEP - rather than read from a transaction value, so a mint sent with excess ether cannot inflate it.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees. Every one of the three flows is paid by a user: the miner pays the entry price, the trader pays the swap fee, and the secondary-market buyer pays the royalty.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus the rent paid out to living cats.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Rent paid to the cats already alive. Every mint splits its price between the cats that came before it and the hook; cat holders are suppliers whose asset earns, not holders of a governance token, so their cut is a cost of revenue. Measured as the mint price minus the hook's cut, which is exact and needs no reconstruction from the rent accumulator. The hook's cut is what it was owed in the window rather than what it was sent: a transfer that fails its gas stipend is held in the collection's hookDue and forwarded later, so the change in that balance is added back.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of revenue that joins the hook's buyback queue and is spent buying $HASH back on the pool and burning it. Measured at the fee source - the moment the hook receives and splits the money - rather than when a buyback executes, since the queue is drained gradually under a per-block cap.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The developer's share of revenue, at the hook's devBps rate, read from the chain rather than hardcoded.

Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: The price paid for every cat mined in the window, derived per cat from the contract's price curve.
Fees.Token Swap Fees: The trading fee the hook takes on $HASH swaps. The pool's own fee is zero, so this is the whole of it. The rate decays from its opening value to its target over the first ten minutes of trading, so the amounts are read from FeeTaken rather than computed.
Fees.Creator Fees: Secondary-market royalties, which the collection routes to the hook as the ERC-2981 recipient - in ether, or in WETH when the sale settled in WETH.

UserFees.Mint/Redeem Fees: The price paid for every cat mined in the window.
UserFees.Token Swap Fees: The trading fee paid by swappers on the $HASH pool.

Revenue.Token Buy Back: The part of revenue that joins the buyback queue.
Revenue.Protocol Fees: The developer's share of revenue, at the hook's devBps rate.

SupplySideRevenue.Rent to Cat Holders: Rent accrued to the cats alive at the time of each mint, paid out of that mint's price.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Ether queued for buying $HASH back on the pool and burning it.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: The developer's share of everything the hook receives.

methodology.Volume: Completed swaps through every Route settlement generation (original engines, fee collectors and provider executors, builder integrations and the Route v2 executors: the October 1, 2026 executor, the flywheel executor route.fun and partners use since October 6, and the partner executor), counted once per trade, including integrations and treasury trades but excluding quotes, individual pool hops and swaps sent from or to wallet 0xd5d7c80c9f8ddd278526a2e46f0a57275fa6116d, which Route excludes from its own reported volume.
methodology.Fees: Actual Route swap fees (including builder-integration and Route v2 swaps), integrator fees on builder swaps, partner fees on partner-executor swaps, and ROUTE creator fees from its original bonding curve and Pons pool, excluding gas, other providers' fees, API subscriptions, private transfers and cross-chain fees.
methodology.Revenue: Swap fees and ROUTE creator fees earned by Route, counted once before buybacks and treasury spending; integrator fees paid to builders and partner fees paid to partners are excluded.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Tracked revenue less revenue-funded ROUTE buybacks, which may spend receipts from earlier days; LP funding is a separate capital allocation, not a revenue deduction.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Actual ETH input for early creator-revenue-funded dev-wallet purchases and completed automated ROUTE buybacks; excludes all LP budgets and purchases made for liquidity.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Integrator fees paid to builders on builder-integration swaps and partner fees paid to partners on partner-executor swaps. No other tracked fee receipt is paid to outside liquidity providers or referrers; LP funding is a subsequent capital allocation.

Fees.Swap Fees: Route fees paid on swaps through the tracked Route contracts, using the actual amount charged on each trade.
Fees.Builder Fees: Integrator fees charged on builder-integration swaps and paid directly to the builder.
Fees.Partner Fees: Partner fees charged on Route v2 partner-executor swaps and paid to the partner wallet (in USDG when converted in the swap), from the PartnerFee event.
Fees.Creator Fees: Actual creatorAmount distributed by ROUTE's bonding curve or original Pons pool, including the original dev wallet and every manager recipient; excludes the Pons protocol share.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Route: Swap fees received by Route before buybacks and treasury spending, including Route v2 fees paid directly to the treasury Safe or into the 60/5/35 revenue manager.
Revenue.Creator Fees To Route: ROUTE creator fees paid to its historical or current recipient; later escrow claims, fee conversions and internal transfers are not additional income.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Route: Swap fees collected by Route, before the separate deduction for completed buybacks.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Fees To Route: ROUTE creator fees credited to Route, before the separate deduction for completed buybacks.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Buy Back: ETH spent buying ROUTE, deducted from protocol revenue when the purchase completes; spending earlier receipts can make this period's net amount negative.

SupplySideRevenue.Builder Fees: Integrator fees paid to builders on builder-integration swaps.
SupplySideRevenue.Partner Fees: Partner fees paid to partners on Route v2 partner-executor swaps.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Actual ETH input for 100 post-launch dev-wallet buys funded by ROUTE creator fees (see the historical funding reconciliation) and completed buys from all four automated managers (the current Ramp manager splits revenue 60% buyback, 5% LP, 35% treasury); excludes the launch purchase, gas, and ROUTE bought within the separate capital-allocation budget.

methodology.Fees: The 1% hook fee and the ~3.33% tax PonsV2MemeHook charges on every swap of the genesis SHROOM/MU pool, read from the hook's own sweep events and denominated in MU after the hook converts the SHROOM side. Neither rate is assumed: both come from the events, and the split between Pons and the creator is read from the hook at the block being priced.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees. The hook fee and the tax are charged to swappers.
methodology.Revenue: SHROOM token revenue only: MU allocated for holder dividends in pool-filtered sweeps, excluding Pons. This is not treasury revenue and includes no treasury LP earnings.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: MU allocated to all SHROOM holders from creatorAmount, recognized at the hook sweep. Actual recipient payments can occur later. Treasury holders are included in this token-wide allocation, so do not add treasury dividend receipts again.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 30% of the hook fee taken by Pons, the launchpad the token was issued through.

Fees.Hook Fee: The 1% fee PonsV2MemeHook charges on every swap of the genesis SHROOM/MU pool, recovered from the sweep by scaling Pons's cut up by its configured share.
Fees.Token Tax: The tax the hook charges alongside the fee, 3.33x it on every event to date. Taken as whatever the creator was swept beyond its share of the hook fee, so no rate is assumed.

Revenue.Hook Fee To SHROOM Holders: The creator's 70% of the hook fee, which reaches SHROOM holders through the MU dividend.
Revenue.Token Tax To SHROOM Holders: The tax, which reaches SHROOM holders through the MU dividend.

HoldersRevenue.Hook Fee To SHROOM Holders: The creator's 70% of the hook fee, allocated for SHROOM holders pro-rata in MU at the hook sweep; recipient payments may occur later.
HoldersRevenue.Token Tax To SHROOM Holders: The tax, allocated for SHROOM holders pro-rata in MU at the hook sweep; recipient payments may occur later.

SupplySideRevenue.Hook Fee To Pons: The 30% of the hook fee Pons takes as the launchpad, read from the hook's protocolFeeShareBps at the block being priced.

methodology.Fees: Treasury income only: earned fees from treasury-owned SHROOM LP positions plus actual MU dividend receipts. Token balances and returned LP principal are not income. All-holder SHROOM dividend allocations are reported separately in shroom.ts; do not sum the two scopes.
methodology.Revenue: Treasury income only: earned fees from treasury-owned SHROOM LP positions plus actual MU dividend receipts. Token balances and returned LP principal are not income. All-holder SHROOM dividend allocations are reported separately in shroom.ts; do not sum the two scopes.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury income only: earned fees from treasury-owned SHROOM LP positions plus actual MU dividend receipts. Token balances and returned LP principal are not income. All-holder SHROOM dividend allocations are reported separately in shroom.ts; do not sum the two scopes.

Fees.LP Fees: Earned fees realized when a treasury-owned SHROOM Uniswap v4 position is modified, including collection, withdrawal, burn, and fees offset against new deposits. Read from the feesAccrued return value of PoolManager.modifyLiquidity in Allium's robinhood.raw.traces; principal is excluded. Ownership is reconstructed at the modification. The genesis hook pool is excluded.
Fees.MU Dividends: MU dividends actually received from the Pons distributor by the two confirmed treasury wallets, recognized on receipt. Excludes transfers to other holders, arbitrary MU deposits, and transfers between treasury wallets. Shared MU payouts do not encode which launch generated them.

Revenue.LP Fees To Treasury: Earned fees realized when a treasury-owned SHROOM Uniswap v4 position is modified, including collection, withdrawal, burn, and fees offset against new deposits. Read from the feesAccrued return value of PoolManager.modifyLiquidity in Allium's robinhood.raw.traces; principal is excluded. Ownership is reconstructed at the modification. The genesis hook pool is excluded.
Revenue.MU Dividends To Treasury: MU dividends actually received from the Pons distributor by the two confirmed treasury wallets, recognized on receipt. Excludes transfers to other holders, arbitrary MU deposits, and transfers between treasury wallets. Shared MU payouts do not encode which launch generated them.

ProtocolRevenue.LP Fees To Treasury: Earned fees realized when a treasury-owned SHROOM Uniswap v4 position is modified, including collection, withdrawal, burn, and fees offset against new deposits. Read from the feesAccrued return value of PoolManager.modifyLiquidity in Allium's robinhood.raw.traces; principal is excluded. Ownership is reconstructed at the modification. The genesis hook pool is excluded.
ProtocolRevenue.MU Dividends To Treasury: MU dividends actually received from the Pons distributor by the two confirmed treasury wallets, recognized on receipt. Excludes transfers to other holders, arbitrary MU deposits, and transfers between treasury wallets. Shared MU payouts do not encode which launch generated them.

methodology.UserFees: Fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: 5.5% platform fee on marketplace resales + 2.5% platform fee on rental payments + the 2.5% creator royalty on resales, which is passed through to the original creator rather than kept by the protocol.
methodology.Revenue: Only the treasury-bound platform fees (resale + rental). Excludes the creator royalty.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All treasury-bound platform fees (5.5% on resales and 2.5% on rentals). There is no token-holder split.
methodology.Volume: Gross marketplace trade value: secondary sale prices plus rental payments.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 2.5% creator royalty on resales, paid to the original creator, not the protocol treasury.

Fees.Resale Fees: 5.5% platform fee taken on every secondary marketplace sale.
Fees.Rental Fees: 2.5% platform fee taken on every rental payment.
Fees.Creator Royalty: 2.5% ERC-2981 creator royalty on every secondary sale, paid to the original creator.

Revenue.Resale Fees: 5.5% platform fee on secondary sales, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Rental Fees: 2.5% platform fee on rental payments, sent to the treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Resale Fees: 5.5% platform fee on secondary sales, sent to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Rental Fees: 2.5% platform fee on rental payments, sent to the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Royalty: 2.5% ERC-2981 creator royalty on every secondary sale, paid to the original creator.

methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay copyfomo on every copied buy and sell (a 2% service fee plus the gas copyfomo fronts for them, billed back as one stablecoin transfer to the copyfomo treasury, counted on the day the fee is collected), plus the creator fees of the copyfomo token $COPY: the Pons launchpad hook takes 3% of every swap of the COPY/COIN pool on Robinhood Chain, of which 2.7% goes to the creator (1% hook fee, 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax). Counted on the day of the trade, valued at the hourly COIN price. The fees are swept into COIN by Pons and claimed by copyfomo in batches later; the claims are not what is counted.
methodology.UserFees: The part paid by copyfomo users: service fee plus gas billed back. Excludes the $COPY creator fees, which are paid by $COPY traders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral rewards paid to copyfomo referrers, plus the actual on-chain cost copyfomo pays on users' behalf: the EVM bundler gas and the SOL spent by the Solana fee payer (transaction fees and token-account rent).
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus SupplySideRevenue, i.e. after the EVM bundler gas, the Solana fee payer cost and referral rewards: the service fee plus copyfomo's margin on gas, plus the $COPY creator fees (the 'token fees' figure on copyfomo.com/data). The 'protocol fees, after gas' figure on copyfomo.com/data is the service part before referral rewards.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Buyback & burn of $COPY, funded by the creator fees: what the copyfomo creator wallets pay (COIN or USDG) in every transaction where they buy $COPY from the pool and burn $COPY in the same transaction (the buyback account buys and burns in one user operation). Counted on the day of the buy, which follows the trades that generated the fees. A holder cashback leg (USDG distributed to $COPY holders) is planned and will be added when it goes live.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue minus HoldersRevenue: service revenue and the creator fees kept by copyfomo.

Fees.Treasury inflow: Every stablecoin transfer into the copyfomo treasury. The service fee and the gas billed back to the trader arrive together in one transfer and cannot be split on-chain.
Fees.$COPY creator fees: 2.7% of the COIN leg of every swap of the COPY/COIN Uniswap v4 pool on Robinhood Chain (PoolManager Swap events of the pool), valued at the hourly COIN price on Dune. Rate from the hook's launch config: 1% hook fee with 70% to the creator, plus a 2% creator tax.

UserFees.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: everything copyfomo users pay.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards: USDC sent by the copyfomo referral payout wallet on Base to referrers (its top-ups from the treasury are internal and excluded), plus any stablecoin sent by the treasury back to identified copyfomo user wallets.
SupplySideRevenue.Bundler gas cost: Gas the copyfomo bundler wallets paid to the ERC-4337 EntryPoint for users' operations, priced with the daily WETH / WBNB price.
SupplySideRevenue.Solana fee payer cost: SOL spent by the copyfomo Solana fee payer, which signs every copyfomo Solana transaction: signature fees and the rent of the token accounts it creates, net of rent returned on close (its balance change in its own transactions, excluding its top-ups co-signed by the Solana treasury), priced with the daily SOL price.

HoldersRevenue.Buyback & burn: COIN and USDG sent by the copyfomo creator wallets in every transaction that swaps on the COPY/COIN pool, delivers $COPY to them and burns $COPY from them (Transfer to the zero address) in that same transaction, since 2026-09-11 when the buyback programme started. The three manual buys of 2026-09-11, burned the next day in one transaction (hash in the query helper), are listed explicitly.

Revenue.Treasury inflow: Same as the Fees component: gross service fees before the supply-side deductions.
Revenue.$COPY creator fees: Same as the Fees component: creator fees have no supply-side share.
Revenue.Referral rewards: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Bundler gas cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.
Revenue.Solana fee payer cost: Same as the SupplySideRevenue component, subtracted from gross fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Buyback & burn: Same as the HoldersRevenue component, subtracted from Revenue.

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by users on heks: a fee on every swap in a launched coin's pool, plus the flat fee a creator pays to launch one. The swap fee is charged in the pool's pair asset. It is the protocol fee — 1% in steady state, higher in a launch's first ten seconds to price out snipers — plus, on coins launched from V2.2 whose creator set one, a creator tax of up to 10%. Both are read from the vault's own events: Collected carries the protocol fee and its split, TaxCredited the creator tax.
methodology.UserFees: All fees are paid by users: the swap fee and the creator tax by traders, the launch fee by the creator.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's 30% share of every swap's protocol fee, plus the launch fee in full. The creator tax is never shared with the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's 30% share of every swap's protocol fee, plus the launch fee in full. There is no heks token, so none of this is distributed to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 70% of every swap's protocol fee that goes to the coin's creator, plus the creator tax in full on coins that set one. A creator can redirect both to the holders of their own coin at launch; they leave the protocol either way.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: The protocol fee on each swap, charged in the pool's pair asset: 1% in steady state. For the first ten seconds after a launch it is higher, which prices out snipers of the opening block: up to V2.1 it decays linearly from 80% to 1%; from V2.2 buys pay a surcharge that starts at 99% of the trade and halves down to zero, and the buyer always keeps at least 1%.
Fees.Creator Tax: From V2.2: a tax of up to 10% a creator may set at launch, paid by traders on top of the protocol fee.
Fees.Launch Fees: Flat fee in native ETH paid by the creator when a coin is launched.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: The protocol fee on each swap, paid by the trader in the pool's pair asset.
UserFees.Creator Tax: From V2.2: the creator's own tax, paid by the trader in the pool's pair asset.
UserFees.Launch Fees: Flat fee in native ETH paid by the creator when a coin is launched.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: The protocol's 30% share of each swap's protocol fee.
Revenue.Launch Fees to Protocol: Flat launch fee, kept in full by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees to Protocol: The protocol's 30% share of each swap's protocol fee.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Fees to Protocol: Flat launch fee, kept in full by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: The 70% of each swap's protocol fee paid out to the coin's creator, or to the holders of their coin if the creator chose that at launch.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax: From V2.2: the creator tax in full, to the creator or to the coin's holders.

methodology.Fees: LP fees earned by the listed TickerSpring V7 vaults during the UTC day, including uncollected fees. Measured as the change in cumulative harvested plus pending native-token fees from saved on-chain observations. Excludes principal, stock-price returns, retired vaults and lending.
methodology.Revenue: Earned vault LP fees allocated to operations (10%) and the SPRING buyback reserve (20%), subject to raw-token rounding.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The operations allocation of earned vault LP fees (10%).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The allocation reserved to buy and permanently burn SPRING (20%), measured when vault fees accrue rather than when the buyback executes.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Earned LP fees retained for vault depositors after protocol allocations (approximately 70%).

Fees.Vault Liquidity Fees: Daily change in grossFees plus position.pendingFees, in each underlying token, from the public daily history API. Harvesting moves fees between these counters without counting them twice. Missing observations fail instead of returning zero.

Revenue.Vault Fees To Operations: The operations allocation of earned vault LP fees (10%).
Revenue.Vault Fees To Buyback Reserve: The allocation reserved for future SPRING buybacks and burns (20%), measured when fees accrue rather than when the buyback executes.

ProtocolRevenue.Vault Fees To Operations: The operations allocation of earned vault LP fees (10%).

HoldersRevenue.Vault Fees To Buyback Reserve: The allocation reserved for future SPRING buybacks and burns (20%), measured when fees accrue rather than when the buyback executes.

SupplySideRevenue.Vault Fees To Depositors: Earned vault LP fees minus the accrued operations and buyback-reserve allocations.

methodology.Volume: Gross quote-token value traded against DaWabLauncher bonding curves: fee-inclusive quote paid on buys plus gross quote redeemed from curve liquidity on sells. Post-graduation AMM swaps are excluded.
methodology.Fees: The 1.00% protocol trading fee paid on DaWabLauncher bonding-curve buys and sells, read directly from each trade event. DaWabLauncher charges no separate market-creation or graduation fee.
methodology.Revenue: All DaWabLauncher bonding-curve trading fees are retained as protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All DaWabLauncher bonding-curve trading fees are allocated to the protocol.

Fees.Bonding Curve Trading Fees: The 1.00% protocol fee paid on the quote-token side of every bonding-curve buy and sell.

Revenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Protocol: Bonding-curve trading fees retained by the DaWabLauncher protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Bonding Curve Trading Fees To Protocol: Bonding-curve trading fees retained by the DaWabLauncher protocol.

methodology.Volume: Gross USDG crate spend (crate price + network fee on every open), no netting.
methodology.Fees: Crate spend net of instant-sell buyback payouts (Orderbook trades signed by the Treasury). Can be negative on heavy-buyback days.
methodology.Revenue: Treasury share of each open (crate price minus Pot contribution, plus network fee) minus buyback payouts. Gross of off-chain card fulfillment (every crate delivers a physical graded card).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury share of each open (crate price minus Pot contribution, plus network fee) minus buyback payouts.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The Pot contribution of each open: a fixed bps of the crate price funding the community jackpot paid back to players.

Fees.Crate Sales: USDG the VendingMachine routes to the Treasury on each crate open (crate price minus Pot contribution, plus network fee).
Fees.Pot Contributions: USDG the VendingMachine routes to the PotVault on each crate open (fixed bps of the crate price).
Fees.Buyback Payouts: USDG paid out to players who instant-sell cards back (Orderbook trades signed by the Treasury Safe); subtracted.

Revenue.Crate Sales: Treasury share of each crate open.
Revenue.Buyback Payouts: Instant-sell buyback payouts to players; subtracted.

SupplySideRevenue.Pot Contributions: Pot contributions funding the community jackpot paid back to players.

methodology.Fees: 1% base fee on every bonding-curve buy and sell, plus the creator's optional tax, plus the anti-snipe tax charged in the first 3 seconds of a launch, plus a flat launch fee per token (read live from each chain's factory), plus 2% of the raise taken when a curve graduates to Uniswap v4.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of the base curve fee (10% normally, 30% once a chain is past its first 100 launches), half of the anti-snipe tax, all launch fees, and the full 2% graduation fee.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol's share of the base curve fee (10% normally, 30% once a chain is past its first 100 launches), half of the anti-snipe tax, all launch fees, and the full 2% graduation fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The launch creator's share of the base curve fee (90% for the first 100 launches on a chain, 70% after), their full optional creator tax, and half of the anti-snipe tax charged on their token.

Fees.Curve Trade Fees: Base fee, creator tax and anti-snipe tax on bonding-curve buys and sells, reconstructed from each event's quoteIn and the curve's own immutable bps settings.
Fees.Launch Fees: Flat fee per launch, re-read from each factory since it differs per chain.
Fees.Graduation Fees: 2% of the raise, charged once when a curve graduates into a Uniswap v4 pool.

Revenue.Curve Trade Fees: Protocol's share of the base curve fee plus half of the anti-snipe tax.
Revenue.Launch Fees: All launch fees; the factory forwards them to the platform address on launch.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: Creator's share of the base curve fee, their full creator tax, and half of the anti-snipe tax on their token.

methodology.UserFees: Open fees and profit fees paid by traders.
methodology.Fees: Flat 0.5 USDG open fee per order unless refunded, plus a 5% fee on settled trader profits. Trader losses go to the treasury that backs payouts and are not counted as fees.
methodology.Revenue: Fees minus the builder carve; there are no liquidity providers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Revenue minus holders revenue.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: MOG bought back and burned by the buyback wallet, valued at the MOG price. 70% of profit fees accrue to that wallet; only the MOG it burns is counted.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Builder carve paid to the frontend that placed the order, out of the operations share.
methodology.Volume: Notional traded on mog perpetual markets: margin times leverage of every filled order, plus the notional of every trader close. Liquidations, payout-barrier exits and delist sweeps are not counted.

Fees.Open Fees: Flat 0.5 USDG fee per order, kept when the order fills, is cancelled or expires; fees refunded on a pause, delist or terms change are excluded.
Fees.Profit Fees: 5% of settled profit charged on winning positions at payout.

UserFees.Open Fees: Flat 0.5 USDG fee per order unless refunded.
UserFees.Profit Fees: 5% of settled profit on winning positions.

Revenue.Open Fees: Open fees retained by the protocol.
Revenue.Profit Fees: Profit fees retained by the protocol, net of the builder carve.

SupplySideRevenue.Builder Fees: Builder carve from the operations share of profit fees.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: MOG burned by the buyback wallet after buying it.

ProtocolRevenue.Profit Fees: Profit fees, net of the builder carve.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Buy Back: Buyback burns moved to holders revenue.

methodology.Volume: Civilization anti-snipe pad PadBuy.quoteIn (WETH, Nightshades faction launches) + post-bond faction pool swaps (WETH-side notional of every user swap in the hooked Uniswap v4 faction pools; reopen-window buys grossed up by the same-tx SnipeTaxCollected; the vault's own night rebalances excluded).
methodology.Fees: The Civilization anti-snipe pad snipe tax on Nightshades faction curve buys (PadTaxCollected — 50% next-night boost pot / 10% faction pool / 13.33% StockBooster / 13.33% protocol / 13.34% game creator, WETH); the sunrise reopen snipe tax levied by the game hook on hooked v4 pool trades after each night (SnipeTaxCollected, same five-way split); the 1% LP fee on every user swap in the hooked faction pools (100% protocol-owned game liquidity — the vault is the pools' only permitted LP); and Nightshades faction NFT royalties (ERC-2981 10% of secondary sales) as flushed from the immutable FactionRoyaltySplitter (75% game vault survivor liquidity / 25% team).
methodology.Revenue: The 13.33% protocol treasury leg of the pad + sunrise reopen snipe taxes, and the 1% LP fee accruing to the protocol-owned faction pool liquidity.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 13.33% of the pad + sunrise reopen snipe taxes → protocol treasury; the faction pools' 1% LP fee → the vault's protocol-owned game liquidity position (compounds into game LP, not distributed).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Pad + sunrise reopen tax legs to the next-night boost pot (50%), the faction's own locked pool (10%), StockBooster (13.33%) and the game creator (13.34%), plus both legs of the flushed NFT royalties.

Fees.Civilization anti-snipe pad snipe tax (N: Time-decay snipe tax on Civilization anti-snipe pad curve buys (Nightshades faction launches; 99% at the bell falling to 0 over a 99-minute buys-only window; PadTaxCollected.tax, WETH). Split by the game hook per trade: 50% next-night boost pot / 10% the faction's own locked pool / 13.33% StockBooster / 13.33% protocol treasury / 13.34% game creator.

methodology.Fees: What users pay to cross the bridge. The asset's controller on Arc charges the same rate in both directions - on the way in it mints the fee to the protocol and the rest to the user, on the way out it burns the gross and re-mints the fee - and an optional fast-lane router charges its own cut on top for skipping the queue, on the origin chain when depositing and on Arc when redeeming. Anything charged on Arc is taken in the claim token (bCRCL, bGLD, bUSDT, bBTCB), which is a 1:1 claim on the asset held in custody and is therefore valued as that origin asset; a fast-lane deposit is charged on the origin chain instead, before the asset becomes a claim, so it is taken in the origin token directly. Either way the fee is denominated in the same four origin assets.
methodology.Revenue: All the bridge fees and the fast-lane fees go to the protocol's treasury with nothing paid out of it.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the bridge fees and the fast-lane fees go to the protocol's treasury with nothing paid out of it.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: None. The bridge has no liquidity providers - claim tokens are backed by custody reserves, not by a pool, so there is no supplier to pay.

Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: The bridge's own fee, charged by the asset's controller on Arc at the same rate in both directions: read directly from the mint event, and as the gap between gross burned and net released on the redemption event.
Fees.Fast Lane Fees: The fast-lane router's cut, paid only by users who choose to skip the queue: taken from the deposit on the origin chain, in the origin token, and from the claim tokens on Arc when redeeming.

methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, taken from each Swap event's swapFeeAmount. The Vault charges the fee on the input token; it is booked on the same leg as the volume. When that leg is the output token (a non-core token sold for a core asset), the fee is converted at the trade's own rate, amountOut * swapFeeAmount / amountIn - no external price is used. The amount is exact; only its denomination changes. Because amountIn includes the fee itself and the trade's average rate is slightly worse than the pool's marginal rate, the converted fee reads low by about the pool's fee rate plus the trade's own price impact - a share of the fee, never of volume, and always in the under-counting direction.

methodology.Revenue: Performance fees charged on harvests (arrow fee and strategist fee, paid in WETH) plus trading fees that strategies send to the treasury. The harvest caller fee is not counted as revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Strategist performance fees and trading fees sent to the Arrowfarm treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The arrow performance fee in WETH is sent to the ArrowBuybackBurner, which buys ARROWFARM and burns it.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Yield that stays with vault depositors (gross harvested trading fees minus the performance fee, and the user share of Velodrome gauge rewards), plus the harvest caller fee paid to whoever calls harvest.

Fees.LP Fees: LP trading fees harvested by Uniswap and Fables strategies (gross, before the performance fee), plus trading fees sent to the treasury.
Fees.Assets Yields: Velodrome gauge rewards harvested and converted to the vault tokens, net of the performance fee.
Fees.Performance Fees: Performance fee charged on Velodrome gauge rewards, paid in WETH.

Revenue.Performance Fees: Arrow and strategist performance fees charged on harvests, paid in WETH.
Revenue.Protocol Fees: Trading fees sent to the Arrowfarm treasury by treasury-routed strategies.

ProtocolRevenue.Performance Fees: Strategist performance fees charged on harvests, paid in WETH.
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Trading fees sent to the Arrowfarm treasury by treasury-routed strategies.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Arrow performance fees in WETH sent to the ArrowBuybackBurner (0xd6BF871252d442C1ebBC94333f60e1823ef44cE7) to buy and burn ARROWFARM.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: LP trading fees retained by vault depositors, net of the performance fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: User share of Velodrome gauge rewards.
SupplySideRevenue.Operators Fees: Harvest caller fee in WETH paid to the account that calls harvest (0 since launch).

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: Platform fees paid by GDEX users. Solana: received in SOL by the GDEX treasury, 1% of the SOL side of each swap and 0.1% on SOL withdrawals (1% when bridging). EVM chains: the 1% swap fee paid to the GDEX treasury by the KyberSwap router GDEX routes swaps through; EVM transfer and bridge fees are not included.
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers revenue

Fees.Trading Fees: 1% platform fee on GDEX swaps (Solana: plus 0.1% on SOL withdrawals, 1% when bridging), received by the GDEX treasury: in SOL on Solana, and on EVM chains as the KyberSwap router fee paid to the treasury, mostly in the native coin.

methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees - traders pay all of it; liquidity providers are not charged.
methodology.Fees: Everything traders pay on a swap: the pool's swap fee from the Swap event (protocol fee included), plus what a Latch launch pool's guard takes itself - the creator tax, and on newer launch guards the guard's part of the trade fee - read from the guard's TaxTaken and FeeTaken events. Only Latch's own launch guards are read.
methodology.Revenue: What reaches the protocol, counted when the fee is taken: the protocol fee each Swap event carries; the protocol's share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under the pool's permanent LP lock split, only where the locks provably hold all of the pool's liquidity; and the protocol's share of the creator tax and guard trade fee under the split the guard stores for that pool. A split that cannot be read is never guessed: that amount is left out of Revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All of Revenue. Latch has no token, so nothing is diverted to holders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees minus Revenue: swap fees earned by liquidity providers, and the shares of locked-liquidity fees, creator tax and guard trade fees that go to launch creators and integrators (and any guard-taken amount whose split could not be read).
methodology.Volume: Gross input of every swap on CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager, one leg per swap. Swaps in Latch's own test tokens (LTT1/LTT2 on Robinhood Chain) are excluded: they have no market and no price.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
Fees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Launch Trade Fees: The part of a launch pool's trade fee that the launch guard takes itself (FeeTaken).
UserFees.Creator Tax: Buy/sell tax a launch pool's guard takes after the swap (TaxTaken).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
Revenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
Revenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
ProtocolRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Protocol: Protocol share of the guard-taken trade fee under the pool's fee split.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator Tax To Protocol: Protocol share of the creator tax under the pool's tax split.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Locked Liquidity Fees To Creators And In: Creator and integrator shares of a launch pool's liquidity fees under its LP lock split.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees To Creators And Integr: Creator and integrator shares of the guard-taken trade fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Launch Trade Fees, Split Not Read: Guard-taken trade fee whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax To Creators And Integrators: Creator and integrator shares of the creator tax.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Tax, Split Not Read: Creator tax whose split could not be read; none of it is counted as Revenue.

methodology.Fees: Integrator fee TRNCH adds to swaps and bridges made on TRNCH (0.5% on a single swap, 1% on a swap of a token from the TRNCH Heat ranking or on a basket of swaps, 1.5% on a basket built from the Heat ranking, 1% on bridges), paid to the TRNCH treasury Safe through LI.FI, KyberSwap, 0x and Uniswap. Router and DEX fees are excluded.
methodology.UserFees: Users pay the full TRNCH integrator fee.
methodology.Revenue: All integrator fees received by the TRNCH treasury Safe are kept by TRNCH.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All integrator fees go to the TRNCH treasury.

Fees.LI.FI Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on LI.FI swaps and bridges, credited to the TRNCH Safe by the LI.FI FeeCollector or sent to it by the LI.FI FeeForwarder.
Fees.KyberSwap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees paid to the TRNCH Safe in KyberSwap router transactions.
Fees.0x Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees paid to the TRNCH Safe in 0x AllowanceHolder transactions.
Fees.Uniswap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees paid to the TRNCH Safe in Uniswap Universal Router transactions.

UserFees.LI.FI Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on LI.FI swaps and bridges.
UserFees.KyberSwap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on KyberSwap swaps.
UserFees.Uniswap Integrator Fees: TRNCH integrator fees on Uniswap swaps.

Revenue.Integrator Fees To Treasury: Integrator fees received by the TRNCH treasury Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Integrator Fees To Treasury: Integrator fees received by the TRNCH treasury Safe.

methodology.Volume: Native coin paid on buys and received on sells on ADEXTO bonding curves, gross of fees. Trades by the ADEXTO team's own wallets are excluded.
methodology.Fees: All swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from each Swap event: the creator, curve reserve, buyback and protocol legs. Rates are set per market at launch and never change; the launch presets are 1.00% on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets and 0.40% on factory 0.11.0 markets.
methodology.UserFees: All swap fees paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol leg of every swap, paid to the ADEXTO protocol treasury: 0.10% of the trade on factory 0.11.0, 0.12.0 and 1.0.0 markets, where it is a factory constant. Factory 0.10.0 markets have no protocol leg.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The creator leg paid to each market's creator, the reserve leg that stays in the market's curve, and the buyback leg that buys and burns the market's own token.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid on ADEXTO bonding curves, read from the fee legs every Swap event carries.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on ADEXTO bonding curves.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The protocol leg, accrued on each curve and claimable only to the immutable ADEXTO protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: The creator leg, claimable only to the market's immutable creator. Launch presets: 0.70% of each trade on factory 1.0.0 and 0.12.0 markets, 0.10% on factory 0.11.0 markets; actual amounts are read from each Swap event.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Curve Reserves: The depth leg, which stays in the market's curve reserve and raises its price floor.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Token Buyback And Burn: The buyback leg, spent only on buying and burning the market's own token.

methodology.Fees: Actual quote-asset swap charges emitted by the verified TaxHook FeesAccrued event. V1 launches charge no trading tax. No token mint allocation, gas, deposits, claim payments or buyback execution is counted as a new fee.
methodology.Revenue: Treasury allocation of each fee on an accrual basis; excludes creators, referrers and launched-token buybacks.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The same treasury allocation as Revenue. Fledgo has no own-token holder revenue.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator recipients, attributed referrers and launched-token buyback allocations. Missing referrers retain their allocation for creators. Buybacks benefit the launched token, not a Fledgo governance token.

Fees.Trading fees: Exact totalFee in FeesAccrued, denominated in that registered pool configuration quote asset. Native ETH and native Arc USDC are 18-decimal raw amounts; ERC-20 quotes retain their own decimals. USD totals depend on DefiLlama historical price coverage.

Revenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading fees to treasury: The immutable 40-bps protocol charge plus integer rounding dust, equal to the emitted total fee minus the gross quote amount times creatorBps floored per swap.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to creator recipients: Per-swap gross quote times immutable creatorBps, minus buyback allocation and referral allocation only when the event names a nonzero referrer.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to referrers: Per-swap gross quote times referralBps floored, only for an authenticated nonzero FeesAccrued referrer. Later claims are excluded.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading fees to launched-token buybacks: Per-swap gross quote times buybackBps floored; later buybacks and burns settle this allocation and are not new fees or protocol-holder revenue.

methodology.BridgeVolume: Volume of completed cross-chain transfers routed through LilSwap, counted on the source chain.
methodology.Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.UserFees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: Bridge fees paid by users on completed transfers.

Revenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees To Protocol: Bridge fees retained by LilSwap after partner share.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees To Partners: Bridge fees paid to bridge providers and partners.

methodology.Fees: Everything PeddleQuest charges: the fee quest creators pay on top of the reward pool they deposit, the flat quest creation fee, the protocol's share of rewards that winners did not claim before the deadline, payments for trending and banner promotion slots, and the fee users pay to mint an optional completion badge.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: all of it is paid by quest creators, advertisers and badge minters. Joining a quest and claiming a reward are free.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) are kept by the protocol. Quest rewards themselves go to winners and are not counted as fees or revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees (quest creation, deposit, unclaimed, promotion and badge) accrued to the protocol treasury (a Safe multisig).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The share of badge mint fees routed on-chain to buyback and burn. Zero while that route is switched off, which it has been since launch.

Fees.Reward Pool Deposit Fees: Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
Fees.Quest Creation Fees: Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
Fees.Unclaimed Rewards Share: The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
Fees.Promotion Slot Fees: Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
Fees.Badge Mint Fees: Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

UserFees.Reward Pool Deposit Fees: Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
UserFees.Quest Creation Fees: Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
UserFees.Unclaimed Rewards Share: The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
UserFees.Promotion Slot Fees: Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
UserFees.Badge Mint Fees: Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

Revenue.Quest Creation Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
Revenue.Unclaimed Rewards Share To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
Revenue.Promotion Slot Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
Revenue.Badge Mint Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.
Revenue.Badge Mint Fees To Buyback And Burn: The share of badge mint fees the on-chain fee router sends to its buyback-and-burn address. Zero while that route is switched off.

ProtocolRevenue.Reward Pool Deposit Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Percentage fee (3% at launch, hard-capped at 10%) charged on top of each reward pool when a quest creator deposits it into escrow.
ProtocolRevenue.Quest Creation Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Flat fee per quest paid by the creator in the chain's gas token (free at launch).
ProtocolRevenue.Unclaimed Rewards Share To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. The protocol's share (20% at launch, hard-capped at 50%) of rewards winners left unclaimed after the claim deadline; the rest returns to the quest creator.
ProtocolRevenue.Promotion Slot Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Payments by advertisers for trending and banner slots, priced per day in the chain's gas token.
ProtocolRevenue.Badge Mint Fees To Treasury: Sent to the protocol treasury. Fee paid by a user who chooses to mint the optional soulbound badge for a quest they completed.

HoldersRevenue.Badge Mint Fees To Buyback And Burn: The share of badge mint fees the on-chain fee router sends to its buyback-and-burn address. Zero while that route is switched off.

methodology.Fees: Lock creation fees paid by users to Titan Locker, read from FeeCollected events on every lock manager: a flat ETH fee, or a share of the deposited token for ERC-20 and vesting locks.
methodology.Revenue: All lock creation fees go to the Titan Locker fee receiver.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All lock creation fees go to the Titan Locker fee receiver.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: No fees are shared with liquidity providers or other parties.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Titan Locker has no token, so no fees go to token holders.

Fees.Lock Creation Fees Paid In ETH: Flat ETH fee paid when creating a lock, in which case the whole deposit is locked.
Fees.Lock Creation Fees Paid In Tokens: Share of the deposited token taken as the fee when an ERC-20 or vesting lock is created without paying ETH.

Revenue.Lock Creation Fees Paid In ETH: ETH lock creation fees sent to the Titan Locker fee receiver.
Revenue.Lock Creation Fees Paid In Tokens: Token lock creation fees sent to the Titan Locker fee receiver.

ProtocolRevenue.Lock Creation Fees Paid In ETH: ETH lock creation fees sent to the Titan Locker fee receiver.
ProtocolRevenue.Lock Creation Fees Paid In Tokens: Token lock creation fees sent to the Titan Locker fee receiver.

methodology.Fees: Copy trading fees fomo-mcp users pay on every copied buy and sell (1% on copies under $100, 0.5% from $100), plus the creator fees of the fomo-mcp token $FOMOMCP on the Pons launchpad.
methodology.UserFees: Copy trading fees paid by fomo-mcp users. Excludes the $FOMOMCP creator fees, which are paid by $FOMOMCP traders.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (copy trading fees and $FOMOMCP creator fees) are kept by fomo-mcp.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees (copy trading fees and $FOMOMCP creator fees) are kept by fomo-mcp.

Fees.Trading Fees: Copy trading fees on Solana, taken by Jupiter as a referral fee and received in fomo-mcp's Jupiter referral account (the 80% that reaches the account; Jupiter keeps 20%).
Fees.Creator Fees: ETH that Pons credits to the $FOMOMCP creator fee recipient in its fee escrow: the 2% creator tax and 70% of the 1% curve fee on the launch curve, then the creator share of the Pons hook fees on the Uniswap v4 pool after graduation. Counted when Pons sweeps and credits them.

methodology.Fees: Fees charged on bets in every V5 room: the room stakers' fee, the platform fee and the room creator's fee.
methodology.UserFees: Fees charged on bets.
methodology.Revenue: The platform fee, sent to the ElcasTreasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The ElcasTreasury swaps the platform fee to $ELCAS and burns it.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The fee kept by each room's pool for its stakers and the fee paid to each room's creator.

Fees.Bet Fees: Fees charged on each bet: the room stakers' fee, the platform fee and the room creator's fee.

Revenue.Platform Fees To ELCAS Buyback And Burn: Platform fee sent to the ElcasTreasury, which buys and burns $ELCAS.

HoldersRevenue.Platform Fees To ELCAS Buyback And Burn: Platform fee sent to the ElcasTreasury, which buys and burns $ELCAS.

SupplySideRevenue.Bet Fees To Room Stakers: Fee kept by the room's pool, owned by its stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees To Room Creators: Fee paid to the room's creator.

methodology.UserFees: Open and close fees and borrow paid by traders.
methodology.Fees: Open and close fees (a share of the position size, set per market) and hourly borrow paid by traders.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of open and close fees (currently 10 %), accrued for the platform's fee address.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of open and close fees, accrued for the platform's fee address.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the open and close fees and all borrow go to each market's LP vault; the market's creator takes up to 20 % of the open and close fees.
methodology.Volume: Notional of positions opened plus notional closed (full and partial closes, take profit / stop loss), across every margin token's book.
methodology.OpenInterest: Long and short position size open in every market at the end of the period.

Fees.Open Fees: Fee charged when a position opens.
Fees.Close Fees: Fee charged when a position closes, fully, partially or through its take profit / stop loss.
Fees.Borrow Fees: Hourly borrow on the position size, paid when it closes.

Revenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of open and close fees.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of open and close fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's share of open and close fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Trading Fees To LP Vaults: The rest of the open and close fees, kept by the market's LP vault.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Fees To LP Vaults: Borrow, kept by the market's LP vault.

methodology.Fees: The fee taken from each settled round's losing side (set per market, up to 6 %).
methodology.UserFees: The fee taken from each settled round's losing side.
methodology.Revenue: The platform's share of each round's fee (currently 1 % of the losing side).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The platform's share of each round's fee, accrued for the platform's fee address.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The market's house vault LPs, the market's creator and whoever settles the round (bounty).

Fees.Round Fees: The fee taken from each settled round's losing side.

Revenue.Round Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of the round fee.

ProtocolRevenue.Round Fees To Protocol: The platform's share of the round fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To Market Creators: The market creator's share of the round fee (up to 2 % of the losing side).
SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To House Vaults: The rest of the round fee, kept by the market's house vault.
SupplySideRevenue.Round Fees To Settlers: The settle bounty paid to whoever settles the round (up to 1 % of the losing side).

methodology.Fees: Fees paid on room-key buys and sells, the flat fee to launch a room token, and swap fees earned by room-token liquidity. Excludes fees on Spot swaps routed through third-party aggregators.
methodology.Revenue: AlfaClub's platform key-trading fee, room-token launch fees and 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator shares in AlfaClub's own room, the room behind the ALFA token.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: AlfaClub's platform key-trading fee, room-token launch fees and 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator shares in AlfaClub's own room, the room behind the ALFA token.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator key-trading fees, plus 85% of room-token swap fees: 50% to the room's keyholders and 35% to the creator. Creator shares in AlfaClub's own room count as Revenue instead.

Fees.Key Trading Fees: Platform and creator fees on room-key buys and sells, charged on top of the key price (currently 2% + 2%, unchanged since launch).
Fees.Token Launch Fees: Flat USDG fee paid to AlfaClub when a room token launches; AlfaClub pays the launch gas.
Fees.Token Swap Fees: 1% Uniswap V3 LP fee earned by each room token's locked liquidity, counted in USDG when collected; token-side fees are sold for USDG first.

Revenue.Key Trading Fees To Protocol: Platform share of room-key trading fees, plus the creator share in AlfaClub's own room.
Revenue.Token Launch Fees To Protocol: Room-token launch fees, kept by the platform.
Revenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator's credited share of the ALFA pool (its 35% less any part committed to permanent liquidity), since AlfaClub created that room.

ProtocolRevenue.Key Trading Fees To Protocol: Platform share of room-key trading fees, plus the creator share in AlfaClub's own room.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Launch Fees To Protocol: Room-token launch fees, kept by the platform.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Protocol: 15% of room-token swap fees, plus the creator's credited share of the ALFA pool (its 35% less any part committed to permanent liquidity), since AlfaClub created that room.

SupplySideRevenue.Key Trading Fees To Creators: Creator share of room-key trading fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Keyholders: 50% of room-token swap fees, claimable by the room's keyholders.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Creators: The creator's 35% of room-token swap fees, less any part committed to permanent liquidity.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Permanent Liquidity: The part of the creator's 35% that the creator committed at launch to permanent liquidity for the room token.

methodology.Fees: Pons creator fees paid to Mosh bundles (each bundle's swarm contract), plus the one-time raise fee Mosh takes when a bundle launches. The creator fees are also counted by Pons V2 as its creators' share, so this adapter is marked as double counted.
methodology.Revenue: Mosh's share of the creator fees (creatorFeeShareBps, 20% at launch), the raise fee (raiseFeeBps, 5% of the filled raise), and, where the Mosh treasury holds a bundle's fee claims itself, its pro-rata part of the backers' share.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Mosh's share of the creator fees (creatorFeeShareBps, 20% at launch), the raise fee (raiseFeeBps, 5% of the filled raise), and, where the Mosh treasury holds a bundle's fee claims itself, its pro-rata part of the backers' share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The bundle backers' share of the creator fees (80% at launch), including any team share a bundle's creator set out of it, less the part the Mosh treasury holds as a backer.

Fees.Pons creator fees routed to bundles: The creator share of Pons trading fees on a bundle's token, received by its swarm contract (FeesSynced.received).
Fees.Bundle raise fees: The one-time fee on a bundle's filled raise (5%), paid to the Mosh treasury in the launch transaction. The part of a raise the treasury funded itself is excluded, since that fee is the treasury paying itself.

Revenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury: Mosh's share of the creator fees, paid to its treasury at each sync (FeesSynced.toTreasury).
Revenue.Bundle raise fees: The raise fee, all of it Mosh's.
Revenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury as a bundl: The part of the backers' share credited to the Mosh treasury's own fee claims, in proportion to its claim over all claims at each sync ($BUN: all of it).

ProtocolRevenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury: Mosh's share of the creator fees, paid to its treasury at each sync (FeesSynced.toTreasury).
ProtocolRevenue.Bundle raise fees: The raise fee, all of it Mosh's.
ProtocolRevenue.Creator fees to Mosh treasury as a bundl: The part of the backers' share credited to the Mosh treasury's own fee claims, in proportion to its claim over all claims at each sync ($BUN: all of it).

SupplySideRevenue.Creator fees to bundle backers: The backers' share of the creator fees, credited to their claims at each sync (FeesSynced.toContributors), less the treasury's part as a backer.

methodology.Revenue: The protocol's share of open and close fees (currently 10 %), collected in the protocol's FeeVault.

methodology.Volume: Notional of positions opened plus notional closed (full and partial closes, take profit / stop loss), across every margin token's book.
methodology.OpenInterest: Long and short position size open in every market at the end of the period.

Fees.Close Fees: Fee charged when a position closes, fully, partially or through its take profit / stop loss.

methodology.Fees: QUOTUM trading tax collected by TaxSink, measured in NVDA when claimed, excluding Pons platform fees and direct funding transfers.
methodology.Revenue: Claimed QUOTUM trading tax less NVDA paid to the inference provider, with claims and payments recognized when executed; retained funding and later buybacks can make attribution differ within a period.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The fixed 40% share of claimed QUOTUM trading tax transferred to the protocol recipient in NVDA.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: NVDA spent on successful QUOTUM buybacks and burns at the daily bell, excluding failed purchases and direct token burns.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: NVDA forwarded by TaxSink to the inference provider for seat usage, recognized when payment executes.

Fees.QUOTUM Trading Tax: Gross NVDA collected in TaxSink claims before the fixed 40% protocol share is transferred.

Revenue.QUOTUM Trading Tax: Gross claimed NVDA trading tax less executed inference provider payments, including retained funding for future sessions.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Tax To Protocol: The fixed 40% share of claimed trading tax transferred to the protocol recipient.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: NVDA spent on successful QUOTUM purchases followed by burning the purchased tokens.

SupplySideRevenue.Inference Provider Payments: NVDA actually forwarded to the fixed inference payment recipient.

methodology.UserFees: The 4% paid by the owner who repays the loan.
methodology.Fees: On repayment, 3% of principal is paid to the funder and 1% of principal is paid to the protocol. The principal returned to the funder is not a fee.
methodology.Revenue: The 1% protocol fee paid to the protocol address on repayment.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 1% protocol fee paid to the protocol address on repayment.
methodology.Volume: USDG principal deposited into CapsuleLend when a card loan is funded.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 3% paid to the funder when the owner repays.

Fees.Borrow Interest: The 4% of principal paid when a card loan is repaid: 3% to the funder and 1% to the protocol.

UserFees.Borrow Interest: The 4% of principal paid by the owner who repays the loan.

Revenue.Borrow Interest To Protocol: The 1% of principal paid to the protocol address on repayment.

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest To Protocol: The 1% of principal paid to the protocol address on repayment.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest To Funders: The 3% of principal paid to the funder when the owner repays.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees charged by DeepCore pools, read from each Swap event (protocol fee included), plus the fee DeepCore's router charges on fills it routes to other venues, read from its Filled events. Launch-pool creator taxes and launch-guard trade fees are not counted.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees charged by DeepCore pools, read from each Swap event (protocol fee included), plus the fee DeepCore's router charges on fills it routes to other venues, read from its Filled events. Launch-pool creator taxes and launch-guard trade fees are not counted.
methodology.Revenue: The protocol fee slice each Swap event carried, plus the router fee on routed fills. Both are paid to the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The protocol fee slice each Swap event carried, plus the router fee on routed fills. Both are paid to the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of each swap fee, earned by liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Gross input of every swap on DeepCore's CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager, one leg per swap, read from Swap events. Trades the DeepCore router fills on other venues are not counted as volume.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
Fees.Routing Fees: Fee charged by DeepCore's router on a fill routed to another venue (Filled.feeAmount).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fee charged by the pool, read from each Swap event.
UserFees.Routing Fees: Fee charged by DeepCore's router on a fill routed to another venue (Filled.feeAmount).

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
Revenue.Routing Fees To Protocol: Router fee on routed fills, paid to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Protocol fee slice of the swap fee, at the rate each Swap event carried on chain.
ProtocolRevenue.Routing Fees To Protocol: Router fee on routed fills, paid to the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: Swap fee remaining after the protocol slice, earned by liquidity providers.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders on every swap.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on every swap.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol share of swap fees, read per pool from the vault (protocol swap fee set by the protocol fee controller).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol share of swap fees, which goes to the Bush treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by liquidity providers, plus the pool creator fee where a pool sets one.
methodology.Volume: Value of all tokens swapped through Bush pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on every swap.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on every swap.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Share of swap fees withheld by the vault for the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Share of swap fees withheld by the vault for the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Share of swap fees left in the pool for liquidity providers.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Pool Creators: Share of swap fees paid to pool creators.

methodology.UserFees: Gas fees paid by users
methodology.Fees: Transaction gas fees paid by users on Robinhood Chain (ETH), covering both L2 execution and the L1 data fee component.
methodology.Revenue: Transaction gas fees net of Ethereum L1 execution and blob costs and the 10% Arbitrum Expansion Program fee share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Ethereum L1 execution and blob costs paid for Robinhood Chain batch posting and rollup assertion transactions, plus the 10% Arbitrum Expansion Program share of net revenue paid to the Arbitrum DAO and developer fund.

Fees.Transaction Gas Fees: Robinhood Chain L2 transaction gas fees paid by users.

Revenue.Transaction Gas Fees: L2 transaction gas fees net of Ethereum L1 settlement costs and the Arbitrum Expansion Program fee share.

SupplySideRevenue.Ethereum L1 Execution Gas Costs: Ethereum execution gas paid by the Robinhood Chain batch poster and validators for L1 batch posting and rollup assertion transactions.
SupplySideRevenue.Ethereum L1 Blob Data Costs: Ethereum blob fees paid for Robinhood Chain blob-carrying batch posting transactions.
SupplySideRevenue.Arbitrum Expansion Program Fee Share: 10% of net revenue (fees minus L1 settlement costs) remitted under the Arbitrum Expansion Program: 8% to the Arbitrum DAO treasury and 2% to the developer fund.
